stable_traits.personality: determined, decisive, capable of harsh judgment, angry at injustice

factions.name: White Tower
factions.notes: Though she does not yet consider herself fully Aes Sedai in this chapter

characters.notes: Wearing a sul'dam dress with lightning panels. Channels to open Egwene's collar. Has sat in judgment with the Women's Circle and pronounced justice as Wisdom.

stable_traits.personality: traumatized, capable of fierce hatred when hurt, struggling with darker impulses

characters.notes: Freed from a'dam in this chapter. Experiences powerful rage and desire for revenge against her captors. Channels destructively against Seanchan soldiers.

stable_traits.personality: terrified when confronted with truth about herself

factions.name: Seanchan
factions.notes: Sul'dam who can channel but does not know it

characters.notes: Leashed by Nynaeve using an a'dam. Left collared at the end of the chapter as 'justice' for her crimes. Reveals the secret that sul'dam can channel.

stable_traits.personality: compassionate even toward enemies, trying to steel herself

characters.notes: Helps Egwene change clothes. Feels conflicted about leaving Seta collared despite her crimes.
Leads the group through the damane house. Dressed in plain dark woolens like a servant.
Attacked by Egwene with a pitcher and collared with her own a'dam. Left collared as punishment for what she did to Egwene.
Waiting at the docks with his ship despite the chaos in Falme. Insists on keeping his word to wait for the women.
Member of Domon's crew. Tries to cut the mooring cable to escape but is stopped by Domon.
Member of Domon's crew. Urges Domon to leave while the Seanchan are distracted.
Leading a thousand Children of the Light toward Falme. Sends Byar away before the advance.
Ordered by Bornhald to leave before the battle. Reluctantly obeys.

stable_traits.physical_traits: blood crusted on cheek, cuts from Turak
stable_traits.personality: concerned for others, sensing connections to people in danger

characters.notes: Has an odd feeling that threads of his life are in danger in Falme, including Egwene. Wounded from a fight with Turak. Trying to escape with the Horn of Valere.

stable_traits.personality: guilt-ridden, seeking redemption, ultimately choosing honor

factions.name: The Shadow
factions.notes: Confesses to being a Darkfriend who now seeks redemption

characters.notes: Confesses to Rand that he is a Darkfriend, that he arranged for Fain to enter Fal Dara. Chooses to redeem himself by holding off Seanchan to let Rand escape. Preparing to 'Sheathe the Sword' (die honorably).
With Perrin watching a Seanchan patrol. Part of the group trying to escape Falme with the Horn.
With Mat watching a Seanchan patrol. Part of the group trying to escape Falme with the Horn.
Reports patrol movements. Gasps when Rand gives Ingtar the last embrace of the mother. Clearly shocked by what is happening.
Mentioned as having fought and wounded Rand. His banner (golden hawk clutching lightning) is referenced.
Egwene mentions knowing the stable where Bela is kept but cannot retrieve her. They must leave Bela behind.
Mentioned only in Egwene's dream/fantasy of rescue. Not actually present in the chapter.
Mentioned by Ingtar as having brought them to Falme via Portal Stone, where he lived other lives.

Mentioned by Ingtar as having given Rand the charge for the Horn (though Ingtar says she should have done so from the start). Also mentioned as a possible target of an arrow shot by someone Ingtar let into Fal Dara.
Domon's ship waiting at the harbor. Not a character but a named vessel that acts as the means of escape.

appearances.whereabouts: Falme; the damane house, then fleeing through the streets toward the harbor
appearances.notable_actions: Leads the rescue of Egwene. Channels to open Egwene's collar. Decides to leave Seta and Renna collared as justice. Tries to lead the group to safety but they are attacked by damane. Channels lightning in response to a fireball attack.
appearances.demeanor: determined, commanding, struggling with anger and the moral weight of her decision to leave the sul'dam collared

appearances.whereabouts: Falme; collared in a small room in the damane house, then freed and fleeing toward the harbor
appearances.notable_actions: Freed from the a'dam by Nynaeve. Violently attacks Renna and collars her in revenge. Channels destructively against Seanchan soldiers in the street, creating massive explosions. Reveals the secret that sul'dam can channel.
appearances.demeanor: traumatized, filled with rage and hatred toward her captors, struggling with dark impulses for revenge, determined never to be collared again

appearances.whereabouts: Falme; leashed and led through the damane house, left collared in Egwene's former room
appearances.notable_actions: Cooperates with the rescue out of terror. Left collared at the end as punishment for her crimes as a sul'dam.
appearances.demeanor: terrified, trembling, in denial about being able to channel, pleading not to be left collared

appearances.whereabouts: Falme; in the damane house and fleeing through the streets
appearances.notable_actions: Helps Egwene change clothes. Carries a bundle of clothing. Expresses compassion for Seta despite her crimes. Separated from Nynaeve when they dive into different alleys to escape a fireball.
appearances.demeanor: nervous, compassionate, trying to steel herself to the harsh realities

appearances.whereabouts: Falme; leading the group through the damane house and fleeing through the streets
appearances.notable_actions: Leads the rescue party to Egwene's room. Dressed as a servant. Separated from Nynaeve when fleeing the fireball attack.
appearances.demeanor: practical, grimly acknowledging the sul'dam deserve punishment

appearances.whereabouts: Falme; enters Egwene's room in the damane house, is attacked and collared
appearances.notable_actions: Enters the room demanding to know what is happening. Is attacked by Egwene with a pitcher, then collared with her own a'dam. Left collared as punishment.
appearances.demeanor: authoritative and demanding at first, then terrified and disbelieving when collared

appearances.whereabouts: At the docks in Falme harbor, on his ship Spray
appearances.notable_actions: Waits for Nynaeve and the others despite the chaos. Prevents his crew from cutting the mooring cables and fleeing. Insists he gave his word to wait.
appearances.demeanor: stubborn, determined, honorable, increasingly anxious about the delay

appearances.whereabouts: On the Spray at Falme harbor
appearances.notable_actions: Tries to cut the mooring cable to escape but is stopped by Domon.

appearances.whereabouts: On the Spray at Falme harbor
appearances.notable_actions: Urges Domon to flee while the Seanchan are distracted.

appearances.whereabouts: In the hills outside Falme, leading a thousand Children of the Light
appearances.notable_actions: Orders Byar to leave. Commands the legion to advance at a walk toward Falme.

appearances.whereabouts: With Bornhald's forces in the hills outside Falme, then sent away
appearances.notable_actions: Reluctantly obeys Bornhald's order to leave.
appearances.demeanor: reluctant, showing every sign of not wanting to go

appearances.whereabouts: In an alley between two stables in Falme, near where they left their horses
appearances.notable_actions: Watches Seanchan patrols. Has an odd feeling that threads of his life are in danger in Falme, including Egwene. Listens to Ingtar's confession. Gives Ingtar the last embrace of the mother. Flees with Hurin after leaving Ingtar to hold the Seanchan.
appearances.demeanor: concerned, confused by the chaos, shocked by Ingtar's revelation, compassionate toward Ingtar

appearances.whereabouts: In an alley between two stables in Falme
appearances.notable_actions: Confesses to Rand that he is a Darkfriend who let Fain into Fal Dara. Reveals he has been seeking redemption by sounding the Horn. Chooses to remain behind and hold off the Seanchan to allow Rand and the others to escape with the Horn. Prepares to 'Sheathe the Sword' (die fighting).
appearances.demeanor: guilt-ridden, confessional, seeking redemption, ultimately achieving peace and contentment with his choice to die honorably

appearances.whereabouts: At the other end of the alley in Falme, watching a Seanchan patrol
appearances.notable_actions: Watches Seanchan patrol with Perrin. Goes on ahead when the patrol turns away.

appearances.whereabouts: At the other end of the alley in Falme, watching a Seanchan patrol
appearances.notable_actions: Watches Seanchan patrol with Mat. Goes on ahead when the patrol turns away.

appearances.whereabouts: In the alley with Rand and Ingtar in Falme
appearances.notable_actions: Reports that the patrol turned aside. Witnesses Ingtar's decision to stay behind. Gasps when Rand gives Ingtar the last embrace of the mother, clearly shocked. Flees with Rand.
appearances.demeanor: anxious, shocked by what is happening with Ingtar

relationships.description: Nynaeve leads the rescue of Egwene and counsels her against becoming like her tormentors
Nynaeve leashes Seta and leaves her collared as punishment for her crimes as a sul'dam
Seta was one of Egwene's sul'dam captors; Egwene wants to make her suffer as she suffered
Renna was Egwene's sul'dam captor; Egwene violently attacks and collars her in revenge
Rand senses Egwene is in danger and feels she is one of the threads of his life that must be protected
Ingtar confesses his betrayal to Rand and seeks redemption; Rand shows him compassion and grants him the last embrace of the mother
Ingtar was a Darkfriend who now seeks redemption by sacrificing himself
Domon waits with his ship to help Nynaeve and the others escape despite great danger
Bornhald commands Byar and sends him away before leading the Children into battle

_meta.chapter_title: To Come Out of the Shadow
